items.titleEn: Gold's $4,000 support breaks, but is the selloff overdone?
items.summaryEn: (Kitco News) - The gold market can’t catch a break as prices have fallen below a key pivot level ahead of the weekend, even as U.S. 10-year Treasury yields have dropped below 5%. Analysts note that gold’s bullish momentum has been hindered by persistent inflation, which has forced the Federal Reserve to enter a tightening cycle, driving interest rates and real yields higher and increasing the opportunity cost of holding the non-yielding precious metal. However, Thursday saw a significant rally in long-dated U.S. Treasury bonds as investors sought safety amid growing concerns about equity markets. Although the decline in 10-year yields has reduced gold’s opportunity cost, analysts say technical selling and broader liquidity concerns continue to dominate price action.
